title: Dinner Lady 50ml Shortfill – Tobacco Range – Caramel Tobacco
description:
Dinner Lady’s Caramel Tobacco is a blend of sweet tobacco flavour, a perfect match for vapers who want an earthy, smooth taste with sweet undertones. The tobacco base is paired with smooth caramel, light vanilla, and golden honey to create a layered vape that satisfies every time.
Caramel Tobacco by Dinner Lady comes in 50ml bottles with 10ml space to add in your nicotine shot, with 70% VG you can use this liquid in any sub-ohm device.
VG/PG:
70% VG, 30% PG
Bottle size:
50ml
Nicotine Levels:
Zero – 0mg/ml
